subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “On a small island, students go to school by boat.”?
options: However, teachers found that students walked more calmly between classes.
The club also compared their records with weather reports online.
When the weather is bad, classes may start late.
One cold morning, a student asked him why he ran even when the weather was bad.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「However, teachers found that students walked more calmly between classes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The club also compared their records with weather reports online.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「When the weather is bad, classes may start late.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「One cold morning, a student asked him why he ran even when the weather was bad.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「When the weather is bad, classes may start late.」，答案為「When the weather is bad, classes may start late.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When the weather is bad, classes may start late.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
